departments.name: County of Maui
departments.desc: The County of Maui is the local government entity for the islands of Maui, Molokaʻi, Lānaʻi, and Kahoʻolawe. The $21 million shown here reflects the state's capital improvement appropriations passed through to the county for FY2026–27, not the county's own operating budget.

departments.name: County of Hawaii
departments.desc: The County of Hawaiʻi is the local government entity for the island of Hawaiʻi. The $15 million shown here reflects the state's capital improvement appropriations passed through to the county for FY2026–27, not the county's own operating budget.

departments.name: Office of the Governor
departments.desc: The governor's office is responsible for the highest level of vision and direction for the state and supports intergovernmental relationships with other states and countries through its executive departments and budgetary resources. departments.name: City and County of Honolulu
departments.desc: The City and County of Honolulu is the local government entity for the island of Oʻahu. The $2.8 million shown here reflects the state's capital improvement appropriations passed through to the county for FY2026–27, not the county's own operating budget.

departments.name: Office of the Lieutenant Governor
departments.desc: The lieutenant governor undertakes projects assigned by the governor, and exercises executive power when the governor is out of state or otherwise unable to carry out their duties. For FY2026–27 the office is funded at $2.5 million and staffed by 17 positions.
